name: com.bigicegames.big.unity.networking
description: Co-op networking toolkit of the BIG ecosystem on top of FishNet: swappable platform/session layer (LAN, Steam; EOS next), race-free session flow, stable player identities, idempotent player spawner, proximity voice chat and walkie-talkies. REQUIRES BIG.Unity and FishNet; Steam provider also needs Steamworks.NET.
